manifest.name: JourneyBuilder
manifest.description: Adjust placement, breaking, and item pickup range with an in-game panel.
keybind.toggle.label: Toggle JourneyBuilder Panel
keybind.toggle.description: Open or close the JourneyBuilder settings panel
config.Enabled.label: Enabled
config.Enabled.description: Enable JourneyBuilder changes for the local player.
config.PlacementRange.label: Placement Range
config.PlacementRange.description: Base placement range in tiles. Item-specific tile boosts are preserved.
config.BreakRange.label: Break Range
config.BreakRange.description: Base tool and mining range in tiles. Item-specific tile boosts are preserved.
config.PlacementSpeed.label: Placement Speed
config.PlacementSpeed.description: Total placement speed, including vanilla bonuses. The final speed is capped at 7x.
config.BreakSpeed.label: Break Speed
config.BreakSpeed.description: Total mining and breaking speed, including vanilla bonuses. The final speed is capped at 7x.
config.ItemPickupRange.label: Item Pickup Range
config.ItemPickupRange.description: Automatic world-item pickup range in tiles.
config.MaxPlacementRange.label: Max Placement Range
config.MaxPlacementRange.description: Maximum placement range clients may configure.
config.MaxBreakRange.label: Max Break Range
config.MaxBreakRange.description: Maximum break range clients may configure.
config.MaxPlacementSpeed.label: Max Placement Speed
config.MaxPlacementSpeed.description: Maximum total placement speed, including vanilla bonuses (up to 7x).
config.MaxBreakSpeed.label: Max Break Speed
config.MaxBreakSpeed.description: Maximum total mining speed, including vanilla bonuses (up to 7x).
panel.title: JourneyBuilder
panel.clearConfirm: Click again to clear all world items
panel.hostOnly: World-item commands are available to the host only.
panel.clamped: Values were clamped to the server limits.
